subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should ClawHub expose this stable root-exported registry bridge now, or defer it until the OpenClaw review/scan consumer and authoritative feed contract are approved together?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately non-authoritative, but its root package export establishes a public integration contract whose source scope and lifecycle cannot be selected safely by patch review alone.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Keep the boundary spec as design input and wait to add the exported helper until the consuming OpenClaw protocol and source feed are jointly sponsored.

options.title: Sponsor v1 now
options.body: Approve the current catalog-feed projection as a supported contract, resolve the branch conflicts, and require explicit compatibility ownership for subsequent schema changes.

recommendation.title: Defer the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the boundary spec as design input and wait to add the exported helper until the consuming OpenClaw protocol and source feed are jointly sponsored.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent package-export and OpenClaw integration history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the public schema boundary.
